author: agent
question: Ever wanted an AI to click around your computer for you?

points.claim: Install it with one npm command.
points.spoken: It's called agent-desktop, and it's open source. Install it with one line: npm install -g agent-desktop.

visual.intent: the one install command, then the version check

points.title: One command to install
points.sub: Install with npm, then take a snapshot.

points.claim: A snapshot lists every element the agent can act on, each with a ref.
points.spoken: Then take a snapshot of an app. You get every button and field, each with a ref you can click.
points.source_note: README quick start: 'a ref for every element the agent can act on'

visual.intent: app to accessibility tree to refs, as the README describes

points.title: Every button gets a ref
points.sub: The agent reads the app, not the pixels.

points.claim: The agent clicks a ref, not a guessed spot on the screen.
points.spoken: The agent clicks a ref, not a guessed spot on the screen.
points.source_note: README intro: 'without screenshots or pixel matching'
points.title: Click a ref, not a pixel

points.claim: If the screen changes, an old ref returns STALE_REF and the agent takes a new snapshot.
points.spoken: If the screen changes, the old ref fails with a stale ref error. The agent just takes a new snapshot.
points.source_note: README: 'returns STALE_REF... take a new snapshot and use its refs'

visual.intent: act, stale ref, new snapshot, retry

points.title: Stale refs retry safely

catch: The catch: you need Node.js and npm installed first.

catch_visual.intent: the two things you install first

cover.visual: designed graphic of an agent clicking a window

media.design: Full-bleed illustration: a laptop desk at night with a glowing agent cursor clicking one button in an app window.
Framed app window with a grid of buttons, each tagged, an agent cursor landing on one tag.
Split: top a red stale-ref warning tile, bottom a fresh green app window with a new ref.

cta: Would you let an AI drive your desktop? Comment DESKTOP and I'll pin the link.
